# Embedded Rust: First Impressions

I spent the last month porting a small firmware project from C to Rust. Here's my honest take.

## The good

- Zero-cost abstractions hold up in practice
- The borrow checker prevents an entire class of memory bugs at compile time
- `probe-rs` makes flashing and debugging painless

## The frustrating

- Async on `no_std` is still rough around the edges
- Crate ecosystem fragmentation for certain MCU families

## Verdict

For a new project: Rust. For legacy C with 10 years of field history: stay put.
